environment_requirements.description: the network is unavailable to the demonstration
environment_requirements.note: reachability of a package index is the strongest network signal this repository records; it is evidence about the environment, not proof that a running demo made no outbound request
read from the module constant rather than asserted; the reporting layer refuses with REPORT_LLM_DISABLED when it is off
checked by looking for the modules that would implement each P1 surface, not by reading a flag: a default-off flag in a build that ships the feature is a flag somebody can turn on
environment_requirements.source: pgx/safety/definitions.py: absence markers of every invariant whose blocker is owned by P1

note: The preflight stops at the first unmet precondition and does not execute the step it guards. There is no force flag and no fixture mode.
